metadata_caption: Backstory ::: As expected, the baby is growing and taking up more space. Because of this, and the fact that Kay is so small, our little bean is running out of room! She has started to poke Kay’s ribs and other parts! 😂 Kay has been having a hard time laying certain ways depending on which position the baby is in! We are trying every little technique to get her to take up space somewhere other than the ribs, but she seems to love to have that foot safe up under Kay’s ribs! 😂 Wish us luck as we go through the last stages of pregnancy! Hopefully we come up with a way to move her, should she ever get into this spot again in the future. #kayandtayofficial #couples #relationships #pregnant
